new_value: NOT A DEFECT -- a deliberate decision, already recorded in the code. Verified 2026-09-15: hire-attestors/src/ssh.rs carries a ponytail comment naming both the ceiling ('an agent holding only ecdsa or rsa keys enumerates but never proves') and the upgrade path ('a sibling verifying constructor per key family in claim.rs, never a second verifier here'), and the refusal is logged so the reason is discoverable in the daemon log. The bead's own text is the rationale, not a bug report: ECDSA needs an mpint decoder whose one-in-128 leading-zero case would ship unexercised unless someone mines a 31-byte scalar fixture, and RSA must stay refused for a reason beyond effort -- .cargo/audit.toml ignores RUSTSEC-2023-0071 on the recorded grounds that RSA code paths are unreachable, so supporting ssh-rsa would falsify that ignore. Reopen when a real user turns up with an ecdsa-only agent.
